hybrid but inverted — DOM-world + single CSS-transform camera (tldraw model) as primary substrate; thin GPU/Canvas2D layer only for ephemeral overlays + far-LOD labels. NOT pure-GPU-world+DOM-overlay. Invariant met by ONE container transform (no per-card transform = no reflow/re-raster); markdown(HTML)+mermaid(SVG) native. Weak-HW bounded by LOD content-swap + culling. Escalate to PixiJS+SDF for far bands only if S1 spike misses fps budget.

R1 DONE. Scored table (top): DOM-world+single-CSS-transform-camera 37/40 > SVG 30 > PixiJS/WebGL 27 > react-konva 26 > r3f+troika 24 > Canvas2D 22 > Motion Canvas 14. Criteria: crisp-text, camera-matrix fit, 100s-nodes-weak-HW, md/mermaid feasibility, hit-test, live-update, React, impl-cost. Refs: tldraw (DOM-world, content stays DOM, overlays->canvas 25x), Figma (full GPU/WASM, custom text layout - the cost we avoid), Excalidraw (two-canvas split + culling). ACCEPTED by orchestrator. Verdict HYBRID-INVERTED (DOM-world + single CSS-transform camera, tldraw model; GPU/canvas only for ephemera+far-LOD). Resolves GOAL tension: enemy is PER-CARD transforms, not DOM; single container matrix = object-size-is-camera-matrix, crisp+zero-reflow. LOAD-BEARING ASSUMPTION for D1/S1: crisp DOM text at 1000% under one composited transform must be PROVEN first in the spike; PixiJS+MSDF far-band escalation recorded if fps fails.
